class.name: NNBTInverter
class.brief_description: Inverts its child's [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] and [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] results.
class.description: Flips [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] to [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] and [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] to [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS], passing [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] and [constant NNBTNodes.SKIP] through unchanged. Use to negate a condition leaf (for example, turning "HasTarget" into "NoTarget") without writing a second script.
